serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Some old lady: O-oh! I found some candy. I-I don’t remember putting it there t-though…
Some old lady: It must have been there for quite some time.
You: Like, months?
Some old lady: O-oh no! I’m using this p-purse first time in a few years!
You: …
You: Thanks for the candy ma’am, we gotta go now.
Some old lady: T-That reminds me, my third grandson A-Alex was always so busy just like y-
